Q1 2026: Amazon revenue $181.5B (+17% YoY), operating income $23.9B (record 13.1% margin). AWS $37.6B (+28% YoY — fastest growth in 15 quarters, +$2B QoQ), now a $150B annualized run-rate business; AWS operating income $14.2B. Cash CapEx $43.2B in Q1, primarily AWS + generative AI. AWS revenue backlog $364B at Q1 (does NOT include the newly announced Anthropic deal of over $100B). AI revenue run-rate over $15B (triple-digit YoY). Q2 guide: net sales $194-199B.

Custom-silicon business grew ~40% QoQ, now >$20B annual run-rate (triple-digit YoY) — ~$50B run-rate if it sold all chips externally; among the top-3 data-center chip businesses in the world. Over $225B in revenue commitments for Trainium, including very large multi-year, multi-gigawatt TRAINING commitments from both Anthropic and OpenAI plus companies like Uber. Trainium expected to save tens of billions of CapEx per year and add several hundred bps of operating-margin advantage. Bedrock: customer spend +170% QoQ, 125,000+ customers, ~80% of Fortune 100; OpenAI models (GPT-5.4) now in Bedrock + Bedrock managed agents powered by OpenAI.

Q4 2025 results (CEO Andrew Jassy / CFO Brian T. Olsavsky): Amazon revenue was $213.4 billion (up 12% excluding FX) and operating income was $25 billion, after three special charges that reduced operating income by $2.4 billion. AWS revenue was $35.6 billion and growth accelerated to 24% year over year, the fastest in thirteen quarters, up $2.6 billion quarter over quarter; AWS is now a $142 billion annualized run rate business. AWS operating income was $12.5 billion, and the CFO put AWS operating margin at 35% through Q4, up 40 basis points year over year, despite the headwind from AI investment and the related depreciation. The acceleration came from both core and AI services, and core non-AI workloads are growing faster than Amazon anticipated.
quarterly_data.figure: AWS revenue $35.6 billion (+24% YoY); $142 billion annualized run rate; AWS operating income $12.5 billion (35% operating margin); Amazon revenue $213.4 billion
